Initial release of cutmv-video — fast cloud-based video trimming for creators:

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for quick AI-powered cutting and trimming.
- Simple workflow: connect, upload footage, describe your cut, and download a 1080p MP4 within 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic session and token handling, with fallback to a free anonymous token if needed.
- Supports timeline state management, batch processing, and iterative editing.
- Clear in-chat feedback on processing status and error handling for common issues.
